title: `uint` is a distinct unsigned 64-bit integer, and it costs no bytes a value did not already hold
divergesFromPhp: PHP has one integer type; Novis has two, told apart by `Core\Reflect::typeOf` and by `$x is uint` (`rule:types/type-test`), so a value PHP's `is_int()` accepted answers `is uint` and not `is int`, and the whole 64-bit range is representable
